en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a striped lighthouse on a low rocky shore with small buildings around it. In the foreground are calm waters with a traditional sailboat and other small boats. At the bottom center, handwritten-style text reads 'Alexandria - The Lighthouse', and there is a small printed number '104' at the bottom left. A web address 'www.elia.org.gr' is faintly overprinted on the image.
